subject: Fiscal Year 2021 Budget Meeting Schedule
overview: The committee established the schedule and transparency protocols for upcoming budget hearings and received department reports on health services and English learner programs.

items.title: Minutes and Financial Approvals
items.summary: Approved the January 6 meeting minutes as amended and approved recent bills and payrolls.

items.title: Report of Superintendent
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent discussed a proposed two-hour delay policy for inclement weather, graduation logistics for the class of 2020, and recent community service by vocational students.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2021 Budget Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Adopted a schedule for department-specific budget hearings and approved a motion to record these sessions for public broadcast and social media transparency.

items.title: Health Services Department Report
items.summary: Health Services Supervisor Toni Wray highlighted initiatives including new kindergarten vision screening, anxiety management tools for middle schoolers, and a translation pilot program for immigrated families.

items.title: English Learners Program Update
items.summary: Director Paul Teixeira reported that all schools met state progress targets for English learners and noted that the state is observing Medford's program redesign as a potential blueprint for other districts.

items.title: Credit for Life Fair
items.summary: Organizers announced that the third annual financial literacy fair will be mandatory for all 11th-grade students on April 3.

items.title: Medford Community Fund Awards
items.summary: Diane Caldwell announced $125,000 in grant awards from Encore Boston to various local organizations, including funding for school Chromebooks and music therapy pilot programs.

items.title: Math Supplies and Agenda Formatting
items.summary: Voted to review classroom math supplies during the budget process and referred a request for new agenda formatting to the Rules and Regulations subcommittee.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: The committee passed resolutions expressing sympathy for the families of Francis Kartelli and Vincent Zampel.
